basis: Source-first independent108-bank review completed before accepting additions; exact original108 request objects preserved.

raw_source_references.location: Door token / Closed Doors
raw_source_references.primary_passage: A Closed Door prevents Characters and Intruders moving through this Corridor (Grenade throwing is also affected).

raw_source_references.location: Pions Porte / Closed Doors
raw_source_references.primary_passage: Lorsque la porte d’un couloir est fermée, les personnages et Intrus ne peuvent plus emprunter ce couloir (ni y lancer une grenade).

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What does Careful Movement cost and replace, when is it forbidden, and can a Closed Door be crossed or a miniature stop in a Corridor?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: The request is about Careful Movement, crossing a Closed Door and stopping miniatures in Corridors; it does not request the throwing restriction.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Two Intruders attempt to move together from the same Room through one Closed Door. Where do they end, what happens to the Door, can it later close, and would a Noise-triggered appearance be blocked by that Door?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks simultaneous Intruder movement and Noise-triggered appearance, not throwing.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: How can uncarried Eggs be destroyed with Shoot/Melee, grenades, Molotov and Fire; which Melee penalties are waived, when is Noise rolled and when is the Nest destroyed?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks ways to destroy Eggs and their damage/penalties/Noise, not the Closed Door range obstruction.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You throw a Grenade/Molotov at uncarried Eggs in the Nest from a neighboring Room. Where is the required Noise roll resolved?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Assumes a legal neighboring-Room throw at Eggs and asks only the location of Noise.

accepted_additions.topic: Noise marker coverage across Doors and the entire Technical Corridor network
accepted_additions.novelty: Noise marker coverage across Doors and the entire Technical Corridor network

raw_source_references.location: Example of Noise Roll, right-column illustrated explanation
raw_source_references.primary_passage: Noise markers NEVER affect only a part of the Corridor “on one side of the Door”. When there is a Noise marker in the Technical Corridors space ... it is treated as if it was in each Technical Corridors Entrance on the whole board.

raw_source_references.location: Technical Corridors
raw_source_references.primary_passage: If you are instructed to place a Noise marker in a Corridor that already contains one, resolve an Encounter instead.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Describe entering an empty unexplored Room: tile, Item Counter, Exploration effect, Noise roll and token destination. How do Silence, Danger and an already occupied destination alter the Noise roll?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests movement/exploration and marker destination, not the board-wide persistence of one Technical Corridors marker.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You roll a number for a Corridor already holding Noise, with a Technical Corridors Entrance in your Room. Give the Encounter sequence, Noise removal, token destination and Surprise Attack comparison; do Contamination cards count?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests an Encounter sequence after a Corridor is already noisy, including Technical Corridors Noise removal. It does not establish that Noise originating at another distant entrance already marks this entrance.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Two Intruders attempt to move together from the same Room through one Closed Door. Where do they end, what happens to the Door, can it later close, and would a Noise-triggered appearance be blocked by that Door?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests Intruder movement through Doors and appearance despite a Door, not the spatial coverage of Noise.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: An injured Intruder moves into Technical Corridors with Noise already there. What happens to its miniature, injuries, token and Noise? Can Characters or Doors normally use those Corridors?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests what happens to an existing Technical Corridors marker when an Intruder disappears; it does not request its board-wide coverage.

accepted_additions.topic: Concrete Bandages and Clothes treatment options
accepted_additions.novelty: Concrete Bandages and Clothes treatment options

raw_source_references.location: Example of an Item card, points 4–6 and Bandages illustration
raw_source_references.primary_passage: You must discard 1 Action card to perform this Action. ... Bandages can be used to either dress 1 Serious Wound or to Heal all Light Wounds. ... choose between the two possible effects.

raw_source_references.location: Clothes and Bandages illustrated cards, middle column
raw_source_references.primary_passage: CLOTHES [cost 1; One Use Only; Out of Combat Only]: Discard a Slime marker OR Dress 1 Serious Wound. BANDAGES [cost 1; One Use Only; Out of Combat Only]: Dress 1 Serious Wound OR Heal all Light Wounds.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks the meanings of Dress/Heal and death thresholds, not these Items' available treatment effects.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Explicitly requests the Emergency Room's three treatments; Bandages dresses only one Serious Wound, and Clothes has a Slime alternative. Those are not the Emergency Room procedure.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You perform the Action printed on a One Use Only Item. Besides paying its Action-card cost and showing it, what happens to the Item card after use?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks only disposal after a One Use Only Item, not its effect.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Can Medkit and Bandages be used on other Characters?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks whether Medkit and Bandages can target other Characters, not what Bandages does.

accepted_additions.topic: Fire Extinguisher selects local Fire removal OR one Intruder Retreat
accepted_additions.novelty: Fire Extinguisher selects local Fire removal OR one Intruder Retreat

raw_source_references.location: Character Hands illustration, left-hand Fire Extinguisher card
raw_source_references.primary_passage: [cost 1; One Use Only] Discard a Fire marker from the Room you are in. OR Choose 1 Intruder in the Room you are in to Retreat.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Which Items may be hidden, what do other players see, what is the Inventory limit, and what must happen on use? How are Heavy Items/Objects, added Items and Duct Tape handled?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks inventory/Hands and use visibility, not Fire Extinguisher effects.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: How does Fire Control affect a chosen Room and its Intruders if the Room has Fire, or has none?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks the Fire Control System Room procedure: any one Room, remove Fire and make all its Intruders flee. That does not cover this local Item's one-target OR choice.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You perform the Action printed on a One Use Only Item. Besides paying its Action-card cost and showing it, what happens to the Item card after use?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Only asks One Use Only card disposal.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: A retreating Intruder meets a Closed Door. What happens normally, and what changes under The Way of Moving Weakness for an affected non-Breeder/non-Queen?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks what a retreating Intruder does at a Closed Door; it does not ask how this Item generates a Retreat.

accepted_additions.topic: Taser local Intruder effect versus forced discard of an entire Character hand
accepted_additions.novelty: Taser local Intruder effect versus forced discard of an entire Character hand

raw_source_references.location: Crafted Item illustrations, Taser card
raw_source_references.primary_passage: [cost 1; One Use Only] Choose 1 Intruder in your Room. It suffers 1 Injury and Retreats. OR 1 chosen Character in the Room you are in must discard all cards from their hand.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: How does Craft pay its Action and components, must the result be available, can you inspect the deck, and what Crafted Items exist?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks crafting payment, availability and which Crafted Items exist, not the resulting Taser action.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Can a Character directly attack another, and may an Action still harm other crew indirectly? Give source-supported examples.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks direct attack prohibition and examples of indirect harm. It does not request the Taser's expressly allowed Character-hand effect or quantity.

closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks Smoke Grenade's one-Action-card loss, not Taser's entire-hand discard.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: With Vulnerability to Fire discovered, how much extra Injury applies per damage instance, and how many Injuries for a Flamethrower double-crosshair hit?

closest_old_requests.actual_request: When you Craft a Flamethrower, does it start fully loaded or with the one Ammo of a searched Weapon?

accepted_additions.novelty: Molotov creates Fire and immediately harms every being in its target Room

raw_source_references.primary_passage: [cost 1; One Use Only] Choose 1 Room with an Intruder (the one you are in or neighboring). Place a Fire marker in this Room. All beings in this Room suffer 1 Injury/Serious Wound.

raw_source_references.location: Destroying Eggs
raw_source_references.primary_passage: You can also throw grenades into a Room with uncarried Eggs as if an Intruder were there. ... a Molotov Cocktail destroys 1 Egg.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Can a Character directly attack another, and may an Action still harm other crew indirectly? Give source-supported examples.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests whether indirect harm is permitted and examples, not the concrete Molotov targeting/damage procedure.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You throw a Grenade/Molotov at uncarried Eggs in the Nest from a neighboring Room. Where is the required Noise roll resolved?
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Requests only Noise location after an Egg-targeting throw.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: During the Event Phase Fire Damage step, how many Injuries does each Intruder in a burning Room take, when relative to attacks, and does it trigger an Injury Effect check?

closest_old_requests.actual_request: May you use your Energy Charge directly to reload another Character Weapon; what procedure permits that recharge?

accepted_additions.topic: Evacuation Key activation and local one-Pod lock/unlock
accepted_additions.novelty: Evacuation Key activation and local one-Pod lock/unlock

raw_source_references.location: Quest Item illustrations, horizontal and active Evacuation Key cards
raw_source_references.primary_passage: Activation [cost 1]: Activate this Item in the Fire Control System Room. Active [cost 1; One Use Only; Out of Combat Only]: If you are in the Evacuation Section Room, Lock or Unlock 1 of the Escape Pods in that Evacuation Section.

Is it possible to activate a Quest Item in a Room with a Malfunction marker? Yes.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What permits or prevents entering an Escape Pod, what must you resolve first, how many Characters and Heavy Objects fit, and what are the options and consequences when you wait?

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What does Hatch Control System change and how does Monitoring Room inspect a location: explored or unexplored, what components, secrecy and replacement?

closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks type of Quest activation, Combat and Malfunction; it does not ask this card's location/effect.
